title: Apple's new Mac software cleaned up years of messy files that accumulated on my desktop in less than a second (AAPL)
text: Apple's new Mac software cleaned up years of messy files that accumulated on my desktop in less than a second (AAPL) By Dave Smith Sep 25, 2018, 9:17 am 6 pts Apple on Monday released MacOS Mojave, its latest free software update for Mac computers. One of the best features introduced in MacOS Mojave is called Stacks, which automatically organizes all of your files into neat piles, grouped in the way you like.
